query:
SELECT COALESCE(
                   (SELECT entity_id FROM stream_variants WHERE vod_item_id = ?),
                   (SELECT s.entity_id FROM vod_items v
                    JOIN stream_variants s
                      ON s.source_id = v.source_id AND s.binding_key = v.binding_key
                    WHERE v.id = ?)
               ) as "entity_id?: String"
